'''Dunc T'racen''' was a [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] warrior. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], she was teamed as junior partner to [[Shada D'ukal]], serving alongside her as co-pilot and gunner of ''[[The Fury]]''.

==Biography==
Dunc shared [[Shada D'ukal|Shada's]] air of professional competence and carried a similar arsenal of personal weaponry, including several [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], but she seemed less battle-hardened, and still believed that the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard|Shadow Guard]] were more than mercenaries, although her air of youthful idealism was perhaps emphasized by her fair complexion and delicate features.

At around the time that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] abducted [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], ''[[The Fury]]'' was contracted for 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to transport [[Fenig Nabon]] and [[Ghitsa Dogder]] with a cargo from [[Leb'Reen]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Dunc expected the cargo to be [[ryll kor]] for medical use, and was horrified to discover that it was actually a troupe of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancers indentured to the [[Clan Shak|Shak clan]], being sold into virtual slavery to [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

Throughout the voyage, Dunc was continually baited by Ghitsa, and the situation was not improved when the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] ship ''[[Indenture]]'' tried to attack ''The Fury'' and appropriate their living cargo. Shada and Dunc decided to liberate the slaves, and unceremoniously offloaded Fenig and Ghitsa in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]&mdash;only to discover that that had been the plan all along, and they had been unwittingly manipulated into aiding their passengers in a complex con.

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Dunc T'racen is based on noted fan [[Tracy Duncan]], whom authors [[Tish Eggleston Pahl|Tish Pahl]] and [[Chris Cassidy]] knew as the web administrator of Club Jade.
